title: Separating mixed revisions at receiving
titleZh: 進料時區分混在一起的版本

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: We got two items in separate shipping boxes. Each box has the same lot number. The packing list shows two revisions, but the items look the same. Should I put them in one bin?
turns.zh: 我們收到兩件分開裝箱的貨。兩個外箱上的批號一樣。裝箱明細列了兩個版本，但這兩件貨看起來一樣。我該把它們放進同一個料盒嗎？

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: No. Use the small revision mark next to the mounting hole, not the lot number on the box. Enter a separate count for each revision. Leave any board with an unreadable mark out of both counts.
turns.zh: 不要。要看安裝孔旁的小型版本標記，而不是外箱上的批號。每個版本的數量要分開登記。標記無法辨讀的板子，兩個版本都不要計入。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I can read the revision mark on the first card. A label hides the mark on the second card. Should I take the label off?
turns.zh: 我看得清楚第一片板的版本標記。第二片板的標記被貼紙蓋住了。我該把貼紙撕掉嗎？

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Leave the label in place. Set that board aside on the inspection shelf, and tell the inspector where the label covers the mark.
turns.zh: 不要撕下貼紙。把那片板另外放到待檢架上，並告訴檢驗員貼紙蓋住了哪裡的標記。
